column1: The Periodic Table: A Very Short Introduction|2011|0|0||9,6,5,8,8,9,8,10,8,8|Eric R. Scerri|Explains the development and interpretation of chemical classification through atomic and quantum theory. The publisher contents and specialist review distinguish it from an undergraduate curriculum. Historical and philosophical distinctions add value beyond elementary physics, though the reader already knows the underlying quantum theory. Correct original year is 2011, not the metadata match to Scerri's different longer book. Evidence: https://academic.oup.com/book/715 ; https://edu.rsc.org/review/the-periodic-table-a-very-short-introduction/3007165.article

Brilliant Blunders|2013|0|0||8,7,8,8,8,9,9,9,9,8|Mario Livio|Compares errors by five scientists to explain model assumptions, competition and revision. The cases add distinct failure modes rather than merely repeating that experts err. Scientific decisions are central; popular physics content adds less than the error analysis for this reader. Publisher description and library contents inspected. Evidence: https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/Brilliant-Blunders/Mario-Livio/9781439192375 ; https://library.iitgoa.ac.in/cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl?biblionumber=1627

Ignorance|2012|0|0||8,6,8,7,7,9,9,9,8,8|Stuart Firestein|Explains how researchers identify productive unknowns and choose questions. Case histories connect uncertainty with research decisions; the argument is general scientific practice, not specialist training. Its central idea may be familiar to an active physicist, reducing incremental utility. Evidence: https://obnb.uk/p16062557-ignorance-how-it-drives-science ; https://books.google.com/books/about/Ignorance.html?id=SrK7iS3E8nAC

Failure|2015|0|0||8,7,8,7,7,9,9,9,8,8|Stuart Firestein|Essays connect unsuccessful experiments with teaching, funding, publishing and discovery. Distinguishing informative failure from carelessness gives useful strategic constraints. Contents and a specialist review support varied applications, not a direct density measurement. Original release was 2015; some catalogs date a print edition 2016. Evidence: https://www.rockefeller.edu/research/uploads/www.rockefeller.edu/sites/8/2018/09/1-s2.0-S0092867415016360-main.pdf ; https://books.apple.com/us/book/failure/id1028303534

Truth and Beauty|1987|0|10||8,6,6,6,8,9,9,10,8,9|Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar|Lectures examine scientific motivation, creativity and aesthetic judgment, with historical astrophysics cases. The value lies in explanatory reflection, not mastering specialist derivations. Aesthetics and philosophy of science dominate T12 despite strong physics fit. The collection's original year is retained rather than later reprints. Evidence: https://press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/book/chicago/T/bo4432943.html

Lifted: A Cultural History of the Elevator|2006|10|0|1930|8,8,6,7,7,9,8,8,7,8|Andreas Bernard|Connects elevator technology with building design, control systems, social hierarchy and cultural representation. Urban history incurs T11, but mechanical and spatial constraints provide broader transfer. The central transition to widespread elevator use is assessed through approximately 1930, with low endpoint confidence. Original German edition is 2006, English 2014. Evidence: https://nyupress.org/9780814787168/lifted/ ; https://openlibrary.org/works/OL19981858W/Lifted

The One Device|2017|0|0|2017|8,9,8,8,7,8,10,8,8,8|Brian Merchant|Connects component inventions, interface design, organizational secrecy and global production in the iPhone's development. A contemporary review identifies useful technical explanations alongside lower-yield historical detours. Global supply chains prevent treating it as predominantly local American history. Evidence: https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/brian-merchant/the-one-device/9780316546119/?lens=little-brown ; https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/brian-merchant/the-one-device/

Fault Lines|2010|10|10|2009|8,9,8,8,8,8,7,10,8,8|Raghuram G. Rajan|Connects household credit, inequality, financial incentives and international imbalances in the financial crisis. These interacting mechanisms offer strong systems value, though causal allocation remains contestable. US consumer finance is central in both narrative and explanation, so both thematic deductions apply. Evidence: https://www.jstor.org/stable/j.ctt7t8d4 ; https://www.imf.org/external/pubs/ft/fandd/2010/06/books.htm
